headline: “From Myeong-dong to Yeongdeungpo”… Foreign Capital Sets Out to Hunt Seoul Hotels
summary: Foreign investors are increasing purchases of downtown Seoul hotels, then raising asset values through brand changes and room expansion. Myeong-dong and Yeongdeungpo are cited as key areas where tourist access is high.
why: Hotel investment reflects foreign capital flows into real estate and the recovery of inbound tourism demand.
